name: Footage slabs and text
what: Two slanted slabs holding your footage fly up in 3D one after the other in an upright frame, a square one on top and a wide one under it, each overshooting a little before it settles; then a line of text types in under them, letter by letter, small at first, and swells to full size with a glow.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f6-f32 the upper slab grows out of a point in perspective, overshoots at f24 and settles by f46; f20-f44 the lower slab swings in from the middle, overshoots at f37 and settles by f50; f66-f81 the text types in letter by letter (about 2 f apart, each letter dropping into place) at half size; f81-f88 it swells to full size (accelerating) while its glow comes up; then it holds

tracks.name: upper slab
tracks.what: grows out of a point and flies up in perspective, a small overshoot, then settles

tracks.name: lower slab
tracks.what: swings in from the middle, a larger overshoot, then settles

tracks.name: typing
tracks.what: the letters of the text appear one by one at half size, each dropping into place

tracks.name: swell
tracks.what: the text grows to full size and its glow rises

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: everything still (the footage keeps playing, the film grain moves)
